row_checks.rule: issue_id IS NOT NULL OR (squad_id IS NULL AND is_leader_task = false AND trigger_comment_id IS NULL)
input_tokens >= 0 AND output_tokens >= 0 AND cache_read_tokens >= 0 AND cache_write_tokens >= 0 AND (cost_usd_ticks IS NULL OR cost_usd_ticks >= 0)

service_invariants: comment.source_task_id, when present, identifies a task in the same workspace and issue
comment is append-only and has no update or delete query
agent.runtime_id, when present, belongs to agent.workspace_id
squad.leader_id belongs to squad.workspace_id and is present in squad_member with role leader
each unarchived squad has exactly one leader
squad_member.agent_id belongs to the squad workspace
mention targets belong to the issue workspace
task tokens authorize only their bound current task, issue or chat session
agent invocation satisfies permission_mode and invocation targets
terminal task states cannot transition back to a non-terminal state
duplicate idempotency keys with a different request hash return conflict
token and verification comparisons use only persisted hashes
cross-table create, update, delete and archive operations use explicit transactions and locks when atomicity is required
workspace deletion explicitly removes dependent workspace data while preserving schema_metadata, user, verification_code and personal_access_token
